chapter: Kid Rene, Chris Kelly and the bungalow
title: Maple Leaf excursions and Fate Marable's band
summary: The Maple Leaf band played excursions across the lake while Marable's orchestra, with Baby Dodds, played the other boat.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: Anybody else want to ask? Where did you go with the Maple Leaf Band when you went out of town?

Well we went across the lake, went over to Manifel. We played over to Manifel in across the lake, Madison. Manifel, Madison. No, I mean on the St. Mount. Oh, well we didn't go up the river, I mean we used to play excursions. The evening excursions. They have two bands, Faith Martha's Band and our band. Like the meetings, like the picnics. Mm-hmm. But they had two bands. And the Maple Leaf Band had all that work on there, on the picnics. They had wanted the manager of the Maple Leaf Band to take the job to roughly here to St. Louis, to go to St. Louis on his team of capital. But we had so much dates, we was tied up with dates that he couldn't take.
What was Faith Martha's Band like then?
Oh, it was a good band.
Was it an orchestra or a jazz band? Oh, it was an orchestra.

That's what's the Zooty Simpon team left out of here with them. I heard it. Yeah. He was with Faith Martha's Band when we were up there. You remember hearing Baby Dodds play with Faith Martha. Baby Dodds, yeah. Baby Dodds. Drummer. Yeah, your brother played clarin' there. Johnny Dodds. Yeah. Did you remember that? When Baby Dodds was playing drum around here, I was a kid I used to look at him. You never did work with his brother, huh? Who? Johnny Dodds.
I ever worked with him? Yeah.
No. Oh, who was in Faith's band when you were with the Maple Leaf?
Well, they had Zooty Simpon team was playing with him, I know that. Had Foster on bass. I thought it was a big band. I couldn't help them.
